rows.grounds: numeral component forming a compound number with the following noun
locative plural indicating the extent or domain
compound of yoni (womb/source) and yantra (mechanism/device) in locative plural
past passive participle describing those subjected to suffering

items.question: Within what vast number of womb-mechanisms are beings subjected to torment?
premises: The quantity specified is eighty-four thousand.
Beings within these locations are tormented.
items.inference: Beings suffer torment across eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is not explicitly stated in this verse and is inferred from context.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
